sources.quote: TOI-700 is a red dwarf star in the constellation of Dorado, located 101.4 light-years away from Earth.

sources.quote: The single planet TOI-700 d is the first Earth-sized exoplanet in the habitable zone of a star discovered by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS).
